info.title: SEE API Endpoints
info.description: Compact JSON catalog of endpoints, params, auth requirements and request/response schemas for the frontend

endpoints.description: Search public events. Accepts geo, text, and address hints; DB-first then discovery fallback.

queryParams.name: city
queryParams.note: address hint - will geocode if lat/lon missing

queryParams.name: state
queryParams.note: address hint - will geocode if lat/lon missing

queryParams.name: venue
queryParams.note: address hint - will geocode if lat/lon missing

endpoints.description: Advanced search with geo and text branches. DB-first, discovery fallback, re-query and return discovered results.

queryParams.name: status
queryParams.note: comma-separated; default active,planning; use attending to pull the signed-in user's RSVPs

200.description: SearchResults containing items (EventDto[]), count, discovered flag
